message.zh: 26.4.18 是重要更新：适配 9 月 28 日库存标签页、最爱分类、4% 市场税率与强化物品价格步进；修复任务返回、购物车轮转和共享材料计算，新增跨站数据共享与统一备份、公会兑换购物入口、每日盈亏类别及聊天字号设置。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.18 is an important update for September 28 inventory tabs, favorites, the 4% market tax and enhanced-item price increments. It fixes task return, cart navigation and shared material calculations, and adds cross-site data sharing, unified backups, guild exchange shopping, daily P/L categories and chat font sizing. Update on Greasy Fork.
